hItems.title: GWS Giants

hItems.title: ALL AUSTRALIAN
hItems.description: Player has made at least one All-Australian team. Includes VFL Team of the Year (1982-90), and All-Australian teams selected after State of Origin carnivals (1953–1988).

hItems.title: 10+ MARKS
hItems.subtitle: GAME
hItems.description: Recorded 10 or more marks in a single game (since 1965).

vItems.title: BEST & FAIREST
vItems.description: Won the best and fairest medal for their club.

vItems.title: SAM TAYLOR
vItems.subtitle: SAM TAYLOR TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Sam Taylor.

vItems.title: WINNING RECORD
vItems.subtitle: IN FINALS
vItems.description: Player has won more finals games than they've lost.
